discovery: LMAO (Low-level Malbolge Assembler, Ooh!, Matthias Lutter) is a CLASSIC Malbolge (10-trit, 59049) assembler, vendored at MALBOLGE-MB-DATABASE/third_party/lmao. The genealogy conflated it with LMFAO, which is the Unshackled one.
note_lmao_nondeterminism: LMAO output is not byte-reproducible: initialize.c uses rand()%8 to pick among NOP-class opcodes (srand(time(NULL))). Two builds differ in 389 bytes; both run correctly.
claim: CLASSIC_MALBOLGE_ADDER=DEMONSTRATED: example_adder.hell compiles with LMAO to a 55724-cell Classic Malbolge program whose decimal addition (including carry to 4 digits) is identical on malbolge.py, Malbolge-Engine and MalboGost.
technique: uses xlat2 cycles of size 2 and 5 to represent each decimal digit; summing calls the R_ (successor) instruction to advance cycles, then converts back to ASCII.
